title: Mixed Conditionals / Makomami ya Kondisyonɛl
bridge: Na lingala, makomami ya kondisyonɛl bazali na ntina na bango moko te: tokosala makomami ya ntango ya zɛlɛ na ya sika oyo bazali kosala ndakisa ya makomami ya zɛlɛ na makomami ya sika. Na anglais, makomami yango bazali na ntina ya bango moko: protasis (if-clause) na apodosis (main clause) bazali kosala ntango ya zɛlɛ na ya sika oyo ezali na ntina te na oyo moto ya lingala akosala. Mbɛlɛ ya mɛkɛɛ ya mpenza ezali oyo ozali kozonga makomami ya lingala na anglais; bosalema ntina ya makomami ya mibɛlɛ ya mɛkɛɛ na ya mibɛlɛ ya mɛkɛɛ na kosala oyo bosalaka ntango bosalaka bango.
rule: Makomami ya kondisyonɛl bazali kosala makomami ya zɛlɛ na ya sika (type 3 + type 2) to makomami ya sika na ya zɛlɛ (type 2 + type 3). Ntina 1: If + past perfect, would + base verb (makomami ya zɛlɛ, makomami ya sika). Ndakisa: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Ntina 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (makomami ya sika, makomami ya zɛlɛ). Ndakisa: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Makomami: Na kondisyonɛl ya makomami, ezali na ntina te kozanga 'were' na esika 'was' ezali na bato nionso na kondisyon ya sika (If I were...). Kasi, ntina ya makomami ezali kozonga na esika ya kondisyon ezali na mbala, kasi ya koma ezali kozala na esika ya kondisyon ezali na mbala.

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Likɛsa oyo ezali na ntina mingi na bato ya lingala mpo na lingala ezali kosala 'Soki nalɛngi koyeba', kasi na anglais kondisyon ezali na 'past perfect' na 'would' te. Na protasis (if-clause) bosalaka 'past perfect' na 'would' te. Mpo ete, boyokani oyo 'would' ezali na apodosis (makomami) soko. Bozali mpe kozala na ntina ya kozonga na 'if' na mbala ya mbala: 'Had I known...'.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Bosɔli ya pasi ya molɔngɔ: gerundios, infinitivos na modales
bridge: Na espanyole, bosɔli ya pasi ebakama na ntina na 'ser + participio' mpe ekomama na bosɔli mɔtɔ mpe na nzela ya bosɔli mɔtɔ (gerundio/infinitivo). Na ngɔ́ná, bosɔli ya pasi ezali ya kobakela: okoki kozwa 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', etc. Ndakisa ya likolo ezali kobimisa esika ya espanyole na bosɔli, lokola 'debe ser hecho' na esika ya 'has to be done'. Kasi, na ngɔ́ná, motɔndo ekomamaka na bosɔli mpenza (tokokuta 'by someone' soki azali na ntina te), ndenge moko na espanyole tozali na lingenyi ya kosalela yango.
rule: Na ngɔ́ná, bosɔli ya pasi ya molɔngɔ ebakama na bosɔli 'to be' na ntango mɔtɔ, modales to nzela mɔtɔ ya bosɔli, libosɔli na participio ya kosukola. Na modales: modal + be + participio (lok. 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Na infinitivos: to be + participio (lok. 'to be considered'). Na gerundios: being + participio (lok. 'being watched'). Na modales ya kosukola: modal + have been + participio (lok. 'should have been informed'). Kasi, bosɔli ya pasi na preposición ezali kaka na ndakisa ya 'This chair was sat on' (kasi ezali ya kobakela te). Boye, boye, tozali na bosɔli mɔtɔ ya kozala na pasi te (intransitivos) mpe na kobimisa motɔndo: soki azali na ntina te, ekomamaka. Na espanyole, bosɔli ya pasi ezali ya kobakela mpe tozali na lingenyi ya kosalela bosɔli ya ngolo to 'se' ya kozala na motɔ te.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Estilo indirecto ya nguya
bridge: Na español, mpo na kopela na estilo indirecto tozali kosala eloko mpe na ntango ya verba ya liboso soki ezali na presente, kasi na inglés ezali likambo ya sotó na kosala 'backshift' (kobimisa ntango) soki verba ya liboso ezali na passé: 'She says she is tired' vs. 'She said she was tired'. Mpe na inglés, makasi ya ntango ezali mawa te na español: 'will' ekomaka 'would', 'can' ekomaka 'could', mpe ntango ya passé ekomaka (past simple → past perfect). Mpe na inglés, tozalaki na likambo moko ya malamu te, ezali ete tozalaki na kobenga na verba ya subjonctif na ba clause ya reporté, kasi na español ('Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' to 'He said that I should come'), mpe ete ba adverbe ya ntango mpe ya lieu bazali kobima na ndenge moko (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Mpo na estilo indirecto ya nguya na inglés (nivel B2):
1. **Backshift (kobimisa ntango)**: Soki verba ya liboso ezali na passé (said, told, asked), ntango ya verba na phrase ya reporté ekomaka ntango moko: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (to must soki ezali likambo ya sotó).
2. **Kokamba te**: Kobimisa ntango ekomaka te soki molongo ekokí mpe na mokolo oyo tozali koyeba (kasi ezali likambo ya kopona): 'He said he is ill' (azali mambe mpe na mokolo oyo) to 'He said he was ill' (mambe te mpe na mokolo oyo).
3. **Kobima ba pronom mpe ba possessif**: Kobima na ndenge ya kopona: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', etc.
4. **Kobima ba adverbe ya ntango mpe ya lieu**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Ba oyo tozali koyeba**: Tozalaki na kobima ndenge ya kopona mpe na kobenga 'if/whether' mpo na oyo ezali na oui/non, mpe motuna ya kopona mpo na ba oyo ezali na ouvert. Tozalaki na kobenga verba ya 'do/does/did': 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Ba ordre mpe ba demande**: Tozalaki na kobenga 'tell/ask + objet + infinitif': 'He told me to close the door.' Tozalaki na kobenga 'that'.
7. **Ba verba ya modal**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' bazali kobima te. 'must' ezali na kobima to ekomaka 'had to' na ndenge ya kopona.

examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər toʊld ʌs tə stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
examples.translation: Mopesi alobi biso ete tokenda.
examples.note: Tozalaki na kobenga 'tell + objet + infinitif' mpo na ba ordre.

examples.original: She asked me to open the window.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Ye alobi biso ete tokenda fenètre.
examples.note: Mpo na ba demande, tozalaki na kobenga 'ask + objet + infinitif'.

examples.original: He suggested going to the cinema.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒɛstɪd ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.translation: Ye alobi ete tokenda cinéma.
examples.note: Mpo na ba suggestion, tozalaki na kobenga gerundif (suggest + -ing) to 'that + should'.

examples.translation: Ye alobi ete tokenda na kati.
examples.note: Na 'recommend' tozalaki na kobenga 'that + clause' na verba na base (subjonctif).

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Libónga ya kobóngisa
bridge: Na español, po na kobóngisa toli, tozali kozinga likámá ya mboka to kobóngola minoko na ndenge ya malamu ("Nunca había visto algo así"). Kasi na anglais, soki bankolo ya mobuani to ya kozala te (rarely, not only, never, etc.) ezali na ndaku ya libónga, ezali likambo ya likambo kobóngola motó mpe mpe verba ya kobóngisa (to mpe verba 'to be'), lokola na botungi. Libónga oyo ezali ya likambo te: soki ozali kobóngisa yango te, libónga ezali kozala ya ntina kasi ezali ya ngala na ngala ya anglais ya ntina. Bosaleli ya español azali na bosaleli ya kozala na libónga yango te, mpo na español ezali na likambo oyo ya ngala ya kozala na libónga.
rule: Libónga ya kobóngisa ezali soki bankolo to ndako ya mobuani to ya kozala te ezali na ndaku ya libónga. Bankolo ya ndenge oyo ezali: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Likambo ezali: [Ndako ya mobuani/ya kozala te] + verba ya kobóngisa (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, etc.) + motó + verba ya ntina. Soki verba ya kobóngisa ezali te, tozali koyambela 'do' na ntango ya libónga to 'did' na ntango ya kosukola (kasi te na 'to be', oyo tozali kobóngisa na ndenge ya ndenge). Na 'not only' tozali kozinga na libónga ya libala ya ntango: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". Na 'no sooner' tozali kozinga na ntango ya kosukola ya ntango: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Likambo oyo ezali ya ntina na makambo ya kozala na ntina to ya kozala na makambo, kasi tozali kozinga na makambo ya kozala na makambo mpe ya kozala na makambo. Ezali ya kozala na makambo te na kozala na makambo ya kati.

concept_examples.text: Not only did she finish the project, but she also presented it brilliantly.
concept_examples.translation: Te mokolo na mokolo akómaki projé, kasi akómaki kopesa yango na ndenge ya malamu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ prɪˈzentɪd ɪt ˈbrɪliəntli/

concept_examples.text: Rarely do we see such dedication in our team.
concept_examples.translation: Komo tozali na kosala likambo oyo na ndenge ya malamu na groupe na biso.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdedɪˈkeɪʃn ɪn ˈaʊə tiːm/

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered a more challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Nzokande nazali na kopona likambo oyo ya ngala ya malamu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntəd ə mɔː ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.translation: Na mokolo na mokolo te ozali koyeba yango.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː dɪsˈkləʊz ðɪs ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃn/

common_error.wrong: Rarely we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct: Rarely do we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct_alt: We rarely see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.explanation: Bosaleli ezali mpo na español "Komo tozali na kosala..." ezali na kozala na verba ya kobóngisa te, mpe mwana ya kosala azali koyebisa na ndenge ya malamu. Na anglais, soki bankolo ya mobuani ezali na ndaku ya libónga, ezali ya likambo kozinga na verba ya kobóngisa 'do' (na ntango ya libónga). Ndakisa mpe ya kozala na verba ya kobóngisa te ezali koyekola bankolo na ndaku mpe ya motó ("We rarely see..."), oyo ezali ndenge ya ndenge ya kozala na makambo ya kati. Po na kozala na bosaleli te, kokuka: soki bankolo ezali na ndaku, ozali koyeba; soki ozali koyeba te, koyekola bankolo na ndaku mpe ya motó.

levels.label: Basic Inversion with Negative Adverbs
levels.translation: Libónga ya ntango ya ntango na bankolo ya mobuani

examples.original: Never have I been so happy.

examples.note: Bankolo 'little' na mobuani ya mobuani (poco) mpe ezali na kozala na libónga. Na español tozali koyeba 'poco sabíamos' te.

levels.translation: Libónga na 'Not Only' mpe 'No Sooner'

examples.original: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.

levels.translation: Libónga ya ntango ya ntango na bankolo ya mobuani ya mobuani

examples.original: Under no circumstances should you open that door.

examples.note: 'Seldom' ezali lokola 'rarely' kasi ezali ya ntina mpe ya ntina. Na español tozali na 'rara vez' to 'raramente' te.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Makása ya kobondwa
bridge: Na español, mpo na kopesa mbula na motuna oyo, tozali kozua makása oyo ezali lokola 'Fue Juan quien lo hizo' to 'Es aquí donde vivo'. Na anglais, ezali kobundwa na 'it' + motuna 'to be' + oyo tozali kopesa mbula + 'that/who' + mosúli ya makása. Lisúsu ya mpenza ezali ete na anglais, mpe ya 'it' ezali ya makasi (tapezwi koyoka), mpe ya 'that' ezali kobimisa na 'who' mpo na bato, kasi tapezwi kozua 'which' na mikanda yango. Mpe, kozala ya makása ezali ya mpenza koleka na español, wapi tozali kobimisa motuna na ndenge ya koleka.
rule: Makása ya kobondwa (oraciones escindidas) ezali kozua mpo na kopesa mbula na motuna oyo ya makása na makása. Makása ya mpenza ezali: 'It' + motuna 'to be' (na ntango ya kati to ya zala) + oyo tozali kopesa mbula (motuna, oyo ezali kobundwa, kozala ya ntango, ndako, etc.) + mpe ya kobundwa ('that', 'who', 'whom', 'whose') + mosúli ya makása. Mpo na bato, tozali kozua 'who' (motuna) to 'whom' (oyo ezali kobundwa, kasi ya mpenza). Mpo na biloko mpe basúsi, ntina 'that' (to 'which' na makása ya mpenza). Na ntango ya kati tozali kozua 'is', na ntango ya zala 'was'. Tapezwi kozua 'it's' na ntango ya zala (ezali ya mbongo), tozali kozua 'it was'. Oyo tozali kopesa mbula ezali kobundwa, mpe ya kobundwa, makása to mpe makása. Mfá moko: 'It was Maria who called me.' / 'It is the weekend that I enjoy the most.' / 'It was in Paris that we met.' / 'It is because of you that I came.' Mpe ezali makása ya 'what' (what-clauses): 'What I need is a coffee.' Na mokano oyo, tapezwi kozua 'it' lokola motuna, kasi 'what' na ndaku. Makása mosúsi: 'The reason why...', 'The thing that...', 'The person who...', kasi ya mpenza ezali ya 'it' mpe 'what'. Makása: tapezwi kozua 'it' ntango mbula ezali na mwa motuna (tozali kozua makása mosúsi lokola 'what...do'). Na makása, tozali kozua 'It wasn't...' to 'It isn't...'.

common_error.wrong: Fue Juan que rompió la ventana.
common_error.correct: It was John who broke the window.
common_error.correct_alt: It was John that broke the window.
common_error.explanation: Sálá ya mawa ezali kopesa ntango ya kati ya español 'Fue Juan que...' mpe koyoka mpe ya 'it' na anglais. Na anglais, makása ezali na motuna 'it' na ndaku. Mpe, na español tozali kozua 'que' mpo na bato mpe biloko, kasi na anglais mpo na bato tozali kopesa 'who' (kasi 'that' mpe ezali ya mawa, 'who' ezali ya mpenza). Mpe, tokoki kozua ete motuna 'to be' ezali na ntango mpe motuna: 'is' na ntango ya kati, 'was' na ntango ya zala, tapezwi 'was' na 'it' na ntango ya kati (ezali ya mbongo: 'It is was'). Mpo na koyoka yango, kosala makása na 'it' + 'be' + oyo tozali kopesa mbula + 'who/that'.

levels.translation: Makása ya kobondwa na 'what' mpe makása mosúsi

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Nominalisation: Kobongisa boyokani na bosɛlɛ na liboso ya boye
bridge: Na anglais, nominalisation ezali pɛtɛ pona mibeko ya malamu na ya akademike: 'the discovery of' ezali na bosembo koleka 'they discovered'. Na ndakisa ya espagnol, kasi tozali kosalela infinitif na nkɛlɛ ya liboso ya boye (el descubrir), anglais azali kosalela ntango-ntango makita oyo ezali -tion, -ment, -ness. Boye: kasi boyokani bosɔndi na motuya moko te, mpe bosɛlɛ ya boye ezali kobongisa: na anglais, motuya ya ntɔndɔ (to 'of') ezali kotɛka boye, ndako na espagnol tozali kosalela 'de' sima.
rule:
Pona B2, tɛka bango na makita oyo:
1. Boyokani → boye na makita: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Bosɛlɛ → boye: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Makita oyo ezali na mbotaramo: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Bosaleli: na anglais ya malamu, tozali kopɛsa 'the implementation of the plan' na nde ya 'they implemented the plan'. Na 'make' + boye: 'make a decision' na nde ya 'decide'.
5. Mibeko: boyokani mosusu bazali kobongisa te (change → change), mpe boye mosusu bazali na bosembo moko (relation vs. relationship).

examples.note: Makita -ness: kind → kindness. Na espagnol tozali ntango-ntango kosalela '-idad' to '-ura'.

examples.original: The importance of education cannot be underestimated.
examples.phonetic: /ði ɪmˈpɔːrtəns əv ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən kænɒt biː ˌʌndərˈɛstɪmeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Bosembo ya edukasyon ekoki kobimisama te.
examples.note: Makita -ance pona bosɛlɛ na -ant: important → importance. Koyeba na 'e' na nsuka.

examples.original: She showed great strength in difficult times.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ʃoʊd ɡreɪt strɛŋkθ ɪn ˈdɪfɪkəlt taɪmz/
examples.translation: Ye ayambweli likambo mingi na ntango ya mawa.
examples.note: Makita -th: strong → strength. Makita oyo ezali na mbotaramo, kosalela '-ness' te.

levels.label: Nominalisation in Formal Register
levels.translation: Nominalisation na mibeko ya malamu

examples.original: The implementation of the new policy was delayed.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi wɒz dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Kobongisami ya politique ya sika ebimisami.
examples.note: Na anglais ya malamu, tozali kopɛsa 'implementation' na nde ya 'they implemented'.

examples.original: There has been an increase in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr hæz biːn ən ˈɪnkriːs ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.translation: Ezali lisusu kobongisami ya mɛmɛ.
examples.note: Forma ya nominalisation na 'there has been' + boye. Kobima yango te 'unemployment has increased' na mibeko ya malamu mingi.

examples.original: The failure of the talks led to conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfeɪljər əv ðə tɔːks lɛd tə ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.translation: Kobongisami ya negocie akema mawa.
examples.note: Boyokani oyo ezali na mbotaramo: fail → failure. Kobima yango te 'the failing'.

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Baninga ya nguya ya modal: would have, should have, etc.
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga yango na kondisional ya mbekamo (habría hecho, debería haber hecho) to na imparfait ya subjuntivo. Kasi na anglais, bazali kosekisa baninga ya modal (would, should, could, might) na 'have' na participe passé. Lisusu, na español tozali kosalela 'haber' + participe, kasi na anglais ordre ezali modal + 'have' + participe. Boye, 'would have' ezali kosignifier 'habría tenido' te, kasi ezali koyebisa epai ya mambu ya kondisional na mboka.
rule: Ezali kosalema na modal (would, should, could, might, must) + 'have' + participe passé. Tozali kosalela yango mpo na kozonga epai ya mambu ya hipotése na mboka (would have), makambo oyo esalaki te to elobaki (should have), possibilité oyo esalaki te (could have, might have), na makambo oyo tokoki koyeba epai ya mboka (must have). Na ngala, tozali koyonga 'not' na nsuka ya modal (should not have / shouldn't have). Na mikolo, tozali kobongola sujet (Would you have...?). Baninga ya kobundisa: would've, should've, could've. Exception: 'must have' ezali kosalema te mpo na kozwa mambu ya mboka (tozali kosalela 'couldn't have' to 'was not allowed to').

concept_examples.text: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
concept_examples.translation: Nakobimisa yo, kasi nalukaki numéro na yo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd hæv kɔːld juː bʌt aɪ lɔːst jɔːr ˈnʌmbər/

concept_examples.text: You should have studied more for the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Ozali koyeba ete ozali kosala examen, kasi ozali koyeba ete ozali kosala yango malamu te.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv ˈstʌdid mɔːr fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: She could have become a doctor, but she chose art.
concept_examples.translation: Ye akoki akoma doktor, kasi alingi art.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kʊd hæv bɪˈkʌm ə ˈdɒktər bʌt ʃiː tʃuːz ɑːrt/

concept_examples.text: They must have missed the train; they're not here yet.
concept_examples.translation: Bato oyo bazali koyebana na biso bazali koyebana ete bazali koyebana na biso te; bazali koyebana na biso te.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ mʌst hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ðeər nɒt hɪər jet/

common_error.wrong: I would have called you, but I losed your number.
common_error.correct: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
common_error.correct_alt: I would have called you, but I had lost your number.
common_error.explanation: Soki tokomi na español, tozali koyeba ete tozali kosalela passé composé (perdí). Na anglais, na nsuka ya 'would have' tozali kosalela participe passé (lost), oyo ezali forme ya irrégulier. Boye, 'losed' ezali kozwa te; tokoki koyeba yango na mémoire. Lisusu, tokoki koyeba ete verbe ya ntama na nsuka ya 'have' ezali participe, te passé composé.

levels.label: Would have for hypothetical past
levels.translation: Would have mpo na mboka ya hipotése

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Soki nakoki koyeba, nakoki kozala na kati na biso.
examples.note: Tala na ntina ya passé composé na kondisional ('had known') na 'would have' na conséquence.

examples.original: We would have won the game if the referee hadn't made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wʊd hæv wʌn ðə ɡeɪm ɪf ðə ˌrefəˈriː ˈhædənt meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Tokoki kozwa match soki arbitre akoki kozwa erreur.
examples.note: Na ngala, tozali kosalela 'hadn't' na kondisional na 'wouldn't have' mpo na conséquence ya ngala.

examples.original: I wouldn't have said that if I were you.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv sed ðæt ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː/
examples.translation: Nakoki kozwa yango te soki nazali oyo.
examples.note: Construction ezali ya mabe te na español; na anglais tozali kosalela 'wouldn't have + participe'.

levels.label: Should have and Could have for criticism or missed opportunities
levels.translation: Should have na could have mpo na critique to opportunité oyo esalaki te

examples.original: You should have told me about the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv toʊld miː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Ozali koyeba ete ozali kosala réunion, kasi ozali koyeba ete ozali kosala yango malamu te.
examples.note: Tozali kosalela 'should have' mpo na kozwa mambu ya mboka to mpo na koyebisa epai ya regret.

examples.original: He could have asked for help, but he didn't.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv æskt fɔːr hɛlp bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/
examples.translation: Ye akoki kozwa aide, kasi asalaki yango te.
examples.note: 'Could have' ezali koyebisa epai ya opportunité oyo esalaki te.

examples.original: She shouldn't have quit her job so quickly.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈʃʊdənt hæv kwɪt hɜːr dʒɒb soʊ ˈkwɪkli/
examples.translation: Ye azali koyeba ete azali kosala yango malamu te, kasi azali koyeba ete azali kosala yango malamu te.
examples.note: Forme ya ngala 'shouldn't have' tozali kosalela yango mpo na koyebisa ete mambu ya mboka ezali mabe.

levels.label: Might have and Must have for possibility and deduction
levels.translation: Might have na must have mpo na possibilité na déduction

examples.original: The keys might have fallen out of your pocket.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kiːz maɪt hæv ˈfɔːlən aʊt əv jɔːr ˈpɒkɪt/
examples.translation: Biko akoki kozwa na pocket na yo.
examples.note: 'Might have' ezali koyebisa epai ya possibilité ya mboka, te certitude.

examples.original: She must have been very tired after the trip.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː mʌst hæv bɪn ˈveri ˈtaɪərd ˈɑːftər ðə trɪp/
examples.translation: Ye azali koyeba ete azali na mboka na ye.
examples.note: 'Must have' ezali koyebisa epai ya déduction ya logique epai ya mboka.

examples.original: They couldn't have known about the party.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkʊdnt hæv noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑːrti/
examples.translation: Bato oyo bazali koyebana na biso bazali koyebana ete bazali koyebana na biso te.
examples.note: Mpo na kozwa déduction, tozali kosalela 'couldn't have' na ngala ya 'mustn't have'.

translations.ln: Baninga ya nguya ya modal: would have, should have, etc.

title: Participle Clauses / Bandá ya participio
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga bandá mibɔ́ni na 'mientras', 'como', 'ya que' to 'después de que' oyo ezali na verbu ya konjuge. Na anglais, mpo na kosala lisusu malamu mpe na ntango moke, bazali kosenga bandá ya participio (eya ntango oyo ezali to eya ntango oyo esili) oyo ezongisi bandá mibɔ́ni na ntɔ́te. Makasi oyo ezali na ntina ezali ete na anglais, suki ya ndɔ́ta ezali ya mɔtɔ oyo azali na bandá ya ntɔ́ta; soki te, ezali kopesa likambo oyo bazali koloba 'dangling participio' (participio oyo ezali kopɛ́tɛ́laka) oyo ezali mabe. Kasi, español ezali kokɔ́ma na ntango noki na gerundio ('caminando por la calle, vi...'), kasi na anglais participio eya ntango oyo ezali ('walking down the street, I saw...') bazali kosenga bato mike na yango: ta ye kokɔ́ma na likambo oyo esili ntango ya ntɔ́ta soki te ezali na 'having'.
rule: Bandá ya participio bazali kosalema na participio eya ntango oyo ezali (-ing) to participio eya ntango oyo esili (-ed to esika ya malamu). Bazali kosengwa mpo na koloba ntango (mientras, después de), sɔ́kɔ (porque, ya que), ete (si), to kokɔ́ma (aunque). Bandá ya participio ezali kopɛ́tɛ́laka na ndakisa ya ndɔ́ta to sima ya suki, mpe suki ya bandá ya ntɔ́ta ezali ya mɔtɔ oyo azali na bandá ya participio. Mpo na likambo oyo esili ntango ya ntɔ́ta, bazali kosenga 'having + participio eya ntango oyo esili' (eya., 'Having finished my homework, I went out'). Na loba ya pasivo, bazali kosenga 'being + participio eya ntango oyo esili' (eya., 'Being late, I missed the bus'). Bazali kosengwa lisusu na sima ya nkombo mpo na zongisa ndɔ́ta ya relatif (eya., 'the man sitting there' = 'the man who is sitting there'). Bazali kosengwa te na bato mike; na ndakisa oyo, ezali mpo na kozongisa na ndɔ́ta (while, because, etc.) mpe suki ya malamu.

concept_examples.text: Walking down the street, I saw an old friend.
concept_examples.translation: Na kosɛ́ngá na nzela, nakutani na nguya ya nguya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈwɔːkɪŋ daʊn ðə striːt, aɪ sɔː ən əʊld frend/

concept_examples.text: Having finished her work, she went home.
concept_examples.translation: Habiendo terminado su trabajo, se fue a casa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ ˈfɪnɪʃt hɜː wɜːk, ʃiː went həʊm/

concept_examples.text: The man sitting over there is my boss.
concept_examples.translation: Mɔtɔ oyo azali kosɛ́ngá na kɔlɔ ezali mokolo na ngai.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə mæn ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈəʊvə ðeə ɪz maɪ bɒs/

concept_examples.text: Being tired, I decided to go to bed early.
concept_examples.translation: Soki naleli, nakoki kosala likambo na ntango moke.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈbiːɪŋ ˈtaɪəd, aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ɡəʊ tə bed ˈɜːli/

common_error.wrong: Walking down the street, the church was seen.
common_error.correct: Walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.correct_alt: While I was walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.explanation: Likambo ezali 'dangling participio' (participio oyo ezali kopɛ́tɛ́laka): bandá 'walking down the street' ezali na suki moke na bandá ya ntɔ́ta ('the church'). Na español, ntango noki bazali kokɔ́ma to bazali kosenga pasivo, kasi na anglais ezali mabe. Mpo na kozala na yango, kanisá ete suki ya bandá ya ntɔ́ta azali na likambo ya participio. Soki ezali na bosɔ́li te, zongisa na bandá mibɔ́ni na 'while', 'because', etc.

levels.label: Present Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Bandá ya participio eya ntango oyo ezali

examples.original: Feeling hungry, I made a sandwich.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈhʌŋɡri, aɪ meɪd ə ˈsænwɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Soki naleli, nakoki kosala likambo na ntango moke.
examples.note: Participio eya ntango oyo ezali (-ing) ezali koloba sɔ́kɔ to ntango oyo ezali na ntango moke. Na español, bazali kozongisa na gerundio to na 'como' + verbu ya konjuge.

examples.original: She left the room crying.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː left ðə ruːm ˈkraɪɪŋ/
examples.translation: Asalaki kopɛ́tɛ́laka na ndɔ́ta ya kosɛ́ngá.
examples.note: Soki participio ezali na sima ya verbu ya ntɔ́ta, ezali koloba mode to kozala na ntango moke. Eyano: na anglais, bazali kosenga te 'she left crying' na esika oyo ezali ete aleli ntango oyo esili; ezali na ntango moke.

examples.original: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ fə ðə bʌs, aɪ red ə bʊk/
examples.translation: Na kosɛ́ngá ya biso, naleki bukí.
examples.note: Bazali kosenga 'while' + participio mpo na kozongisa ntango oyo ezali na ntango moke. Soki ezali 'while' te, ezali malamu, kasi 'while' ezali kozongisa likambo ya ntango.

levels.label: Past Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Bandá ya participio eya ntango oyo esili

examples.original: Frightened by the noise, the cat hid under the bed.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfraɪtnd baɪ ðə nɔɪz, ðə kæt hɪd ˈʌndə ðə bed/
examples.translation: Na likambo ya lɛkɛ́, nguya akɔti na kati ya ngambo.
examples.note: Participio eya ntango oyo esili bazali kosengwa na pasivo to ete. Awa 'frightened' ezali ndɔ́ta ya participio oyo ezali koloba ete ya suki.

examples.original: Given more time, I could finish the project.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn mɔː taɪm, aɪ kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt/
examples.translation: Soki bakopesa biso ntango moke, nakoki kosala likambo.
examples.note: Ezali koloba ete (si + pasivo). Na español, bazali kosenga 'si' + subjuntivo to 'dado más tiempo'.

examples.original: The window broken in the storm has been repaired.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndəʊ ˈbrəʊkən ɪn ðə stɔːm hæz biːn rɪˈpeəd/
examples.translation: Fɛ́tɛ́ oyo esili na mɛ́tɛ́ esili na likambo ya mɛ́tɛ́ esili na likambo.
examples.note: Na esika ya kozongisa nkombo, participio eya ntango oyo esili ezali zongisa ndɔ́ta ya relatif ya pasivo.

levels.label: Perfect Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Bandá ya participio ya malamu

examples.original: Having missed the train, we had to take a taxi.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ mɪst ðə treɪn, wiː hæd tə teɪk ə ˈtæksi/
examples.translation: Habiendo perdido el tren, tuvimos que tomar un taxi.
examples.note: Bazali kosenga 'having + participio eya ntango oyo esili' mpo na likambo oyo esili ntango ya ntɔ́ta. Na español, bazali koloba 'habiendo perdido' to 'como perdimos'.

examples.original: Not having studied enough, she failed the exam.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈhævɪŋ ˈstʌdɪd ɪˈnʌf, ʃiː feɪld ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Soki aleli ntango moke te, akɔti na likambo.
examples.note: Esika ya mabe ezali na 'not' na sima ya 'having'. Na español, bazali kosenga 'no habiendo' to 'como no estudió'.

examples.original: Having been warned about the storm, they stayed home.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ biːn wɔːnd əˈbaʊt ðə stɔːm, ðeɪ steɪd həʊm/
examples.translation: Habiendo sido advertidos de la tormenta, se quedaron en casa.
examples.note: Esika ya malamu ya pasivo ezali 'having been + participio eya ntango oyo esili'. Ezali ya malamu mpe bazali kosenga na makása to ndɔ́ta.

title: Subjuntivo ya motóma / Subjuntivo formal (mbala mosúsu ezali pona na ye atalela...)
bridge: Na espanyol, subjuntivo ezali mwa na ntina mingi na ezali kosalema na makambo mamasola. Na anglais, subjuntivo ya motóma (to subjuntivo ya makasi) akomi kokufa na ndako ya bato na basúsu ezali na ndakisa ya makambo ya motóma to ya makasi, ndakisa mpe na sima ya makambo koleka 'mbala mosúsu ezali pona na ye atalela...', 'nakoti oyo...', to 'dokotó alakaki oyo...'. Na ndenge moko na espanyol, subjuntivo ya anglais ekomonaka na motóma ya liboso (be na esika ya is) mpe na bosongi ya be (I be, you be, he be). Bato mingi bakoma na espanyol bazali kosala ndakisa ya indicativo ('he is') pona na anglais ya ndako ya bato ezali mawa, kasi na makambo ya motóma basengeli subjuntivo.
rule: Subjuntivo ya motóma na anglais ezali kosalema na sima ya makambo oyo ezali koloba elongo, kolakaki, kosenga, koyeba to elongo. Bosungi ezali: 'that + motóma + bosongi ya mwa' (infinitif na esika ya 'to'). Tokoki kokota -s na motóma ya liboso. Bosongi 'be' ezali kosalema na ndenge nyonso. Ezali kosalema na bosongi koleka 'demand', 'insist', 'recommend', 'suggest', 'ask', 'require', mpe na nkombo koleka 'essential', 'important', 'necessary', 'vital', 'crucial', to makambo koleka 'requirement', 'suggestion'. Na ndenge moko na espanyol, wapi subjuntivo ezali na bosungi nyonso (hable, hables, hable...), anglais ezali na bosungi moko. Na makambo ya ndako ya bato, bato oyo bazali koyeba mingi bazali kosala ndakisa ya indicativo (he goes, it is), kasi na makambo ya motóma koleka FCE to CAE, mpe na makambo ya makasi, subjuntivo ezali mawa. Mpe ezali mawa bosungi na 'should' (Mbala mosúsu ezali pona na ye atalela ye akoki kozala), kasi ezali ya anglais ya mabele mpe ya motóma. Subjuntivo ya anglais mpe ezali kosalema na makambo na 'lest' (ezali ya ndakisa) mpe na makambo oyo ezali na 'God save the Queen'.

concept_examples.text: It is essential that he be present at the meeting.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali ya elongo ye azala na kati ya mibali.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðæt hi bi ˈprɛzənt æt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: The doctor recommended that she rest for a few days.
concept_examples.translation: Dokotó alakaki ye akota mokolo mosi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt ʃi rɛst fɔːr ə fjuː deɪz/

concept_examples.text: I demand that you be honest with me.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti oyo ozala na elongo na ngai.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ dɪˈmɑːnd ðæt juː bi ˈɒnɪst wɪð miː/

concept_examples.text: It is crucial that the data be verified before publication.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali ya elongo makasi ezala na elongo na sima ya kozonga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈkruːʃəl ðæt ðə ˈdeɪtə bi ˈvɛrɪfaɪd bɪˈfɔː ˌpʌblɪˈkeɪʃən/

common_error.wrong: It is essential that he is present at the meeting.
common_error.correct: It is essential that he be present at the meeting.
common_error.explanation: Ndakisa ezali pona na espanyol subjuntivo ezali na bosungi naye (esté), mpe bato mingi bazali kosala ndakisa ya indicativo ya anglais 'is' oyo ezali mawa na bango. Kasi, na subjuntivo ya motóma ya anglais, bosongi ezali na bosungi ya mwa (be) na esika ya kosala na motóma. Pona kopesa yango, yanga oyo na sima ya makambo ya elongo to ya elongo, bosongi na kati ya 'that' ezali na infinitif, na esika ya -s, mpe na ye/ye/ye. Sala makambo ya kozonga makambo ya indicativo na subjuntivo.

levels.label: After adjectives of necessity
levels.translation: Na sima ya nkombo ya elongo

examples.original: It is important that she attend the conference.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɔːtənt ðæt ʃi əˈtɛnd ðə ˈkɒnfərəns/
examples.translation: Ezali ya elongo ye azala na mibali.
examples.note: Tala oyo 'attend' ezali na esika ya -s mpo motóma ezali 'she'. Na espanyol tokoloba 'asista', mpo ezali ndenge moko na esika ya elongo.

examples.original: It is necessary that every student bring their own laptop.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈnɛsəsəri ðæt ˈɛvri ˈstjuːdənt brɪŋ ðeər oʊn ˈlæptɒp/
examples.translation: Ezali ya elongo mokolo nyonso azala na komputer ya ye moko.
examples.note: Kuna 'student' ezali ya moko, kasi 'bring' ezali na esika ya -s pona na subjuntivo. Na espanyol tokoloba 'traiga'.

examples.original: It is vital that the team communicate clearly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈvaɪtəl ðæt ðə tiːm kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt ˈklɪəli/
examples.translation: Ezali ya elongo ekoma na elongo na ndenge mawa.
examples.note: Bosongi 'communicate' ezali na bosungi ya mwa, mpo motóma 'team' ezali ya moko na espanyol tokoloba 'se comunique'.

levels.label: After verbs of recommendation or demand
levels.translation: Na sima ya bosongi ya kolakaki to kosenga

examples.original: The manager insists that employees use the new software.

title: Future Perfect and Continuous / Futur parfait na continu
bridge: Na español, tosilaka futur simple po kozwa mambu oyo ekomela na ntango oyo ekoki, kasi na anglais balingi banzingama ya makasi mingi po kozwa mambu oyo ekomela to oyo ekoya kozala na ntango oyo ekoki. Futur parfait (will have + participe) ezali kopona na 'habré + participe' na español, kasi boye: na español mbala mosusu tosilaka futur simple po kozwa mambu oyo ekomela to oyo ekoya kozala, kasi na anglais ezali likambo ya bosembo kozwa mambu oyo ekomela to oyo ekoya kozala. Moto moko ya bosembo ezali ete futur continu (will be + -ing) azoi ndenge moko ya kopana na español; tosilaka banzingama mpo na 'estaré haciendo' to kaka na futur, kozala na ndenge moko ya kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala.
rule: Na anglais, futur parfait ezali kosalema na 'will have' + participe passé na kozwa ete mambu ekomela ntango oyo ekoki. Mfua: 'By 2025, I will have finished my degree.' Futur continu ezali kosalema na 'will be' + verbe na -ing na kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala na ntango oyo ekoki. Mfua: 'At 8 p.m., I will be having dinner.' Kozala na kozwa mpo na kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala to oyo ekoki kozala, na kozwa mpo na kosolola na motoya mpo na kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala. Na mikanda ya ntango na 'when', 'as soon as', 'until', tosilaka présent simple na esika ya futur parfait to continu: 'When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.' Futur parfait continu (will have been + -ing) ezali ya makasi mingi na kozwa mpo na kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala ntango oyo ekoki: 'By June, I will have been living here for six months.' Mituna ya mabe: kozala na 'will' na mikanda ya ntango; kozala na futur parfait po kozwa mambu oyo ekoya kozala; na kozala na participe passé na esika ya passé simple.

title: Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Bakisi ya ndakisa mpo na kohésion
bridge: Na espanyole, bakisi ya ndakisa (mpo na ndakisa, 'no obstante', 'por lo tanto', 'en cambio') bazalaka na ntala ya koma to na ndelo ya koma mpe bazali kosalema na nzela moko. Na anglaise, bakisi mingi ya ndakisa bazali na ndako ya mobali na motuna na salemi mpe bazali na makasi ya kosalema mpe ya koyebisa te bazali kokabilana ntango zomi. Mpo na ndakisa, 'however' (kasi) ezali kozala na ndelo ya koma, na nzela to na ndelo ya koma na bosaleli ya koma oyo ezali moko te, mpe 'although' (ata) ezali kobatela lisusu oyo ezali na ntina mpe ezali kozala na koma moko te. Kolinga motuya te na kozonga 'por lo tanto' (therefore) mpe 'so' (kasi): 'so' ezali ya kosalema mpe ezali kosalema na ndakisa, mpe 'therefore' ezali ya kosalema mpe ya kozonga.
rule: Bakisi ya ndakisa na anglaise (B2) bazali kobundama na makasi ya kobundama: ya kosala (furthermore, moreover, in addition), ya kosala (however, nevertheless, on the other hand, whereas), ya kosala/kosala (therefore, consequently, as a result, thus), ya kosala (firstly, secondly, finally, meanwhile), mpe ya kozonga (in other words, that is to say). Makisi ya ntina: 1) 'However' ezali kosalema na ntina ya kosalema mpe ezali kobundama na koma; ezali kozala na ndelo, na nzela to na ndelo. Mf: 'The weather was bad. However, we went out.' / 'The weather was bad. We went out, however.' 2) 'Although' ezali na ntina ya kobatela lisusu oyo ezali na ntina; ezali kozala na koma te soki ezali na ndelo, kasi ezali kosalema na koma soki lisusu oyo ezali na ntina ezali na ndelo: 'Although it was raining, we went out' (na koma te na ndelo ya 'although'). 3) 'Therefore' mpe 'consequently' ezali ya kosalema, bazali kosalema na kozonga ya akademike; 'so' ezali ya kosalema mpe ezali kosalema na ndakisa. 4) 'On the other hand' ezali kosalema mpo na kosala mituna mibale, kasi ezali moko te na 'however' (oyo ezali kosala na oyo ezali na ndelo). 5) Na anglaise, bosaleli ezali ya ntina: motuna mibale oyo bazali na ntina mpe bazali kosalema na 'however' bazali na ndamba mpe koma, te koma moko (sala motuya: 'It was raining, however, we went out' → ezali ya mabe, bosaleli ya ntina ezali 'It was raining; however, we went out'). 6) Bakisi ya kosala ('firstly', 'secondly', 'finally') bazali kozala na koma mpe bazali ya kosalema na kozonga ya kosalema. Kolinga motuya ete na espanyole tozali kosalema na koma kasi na anglaise bazali na ndamba to na koma.

concept_examples.text: The company expanded rapidly; however, it failed to maintain quality.

common_error.explanation: Bosaleli ezali mpo na espanyole ezali na ntala ya kosalema na koma, lokola na 'Estaba lloviendo, sin embargo, fuimos a la playa'. Kasi na anglaise, 'however' ezali na ntina ya kosalema te, kasi ezali na ntina ya kosalema, mpe ezali kozala na koma moko te mpo na kosala motuna mibale oyo bazali na ntina. Bosaleli ya ntina ezali na koma (;) to na koma (.) liboso ya 'however'. Yeba kozala na ntala ete 'however' (kosala) ezali moko te na 'although' (kozala): 'Although it was raining, we went' ezali ya ntina, kasi tokoki koloba te 'Although it was raining, however, we went' (ezali ya mabe).

title: Hedging Language / Mokolo ya kobimisa
bridge: Na lingála, tozali kozua mbula mpo na kosalela mpo na komonisa boye mabe. Na anglais, hedging ezali kotambola na bokasi ya verbes modaux, adverbes mpe makasi ya kokamba oyo ebimisaka makambo. Molongo moko mpenza ezali kopesa 'tiendo a' mpo na 'tend to' na nzela ya kozala na verbe ya solo, to kozua 'apparently' mpo na 'seemingly'. Awa, ozote ya komona ndenge ya kobimisa makambo lokola mokolo oyo azali kozala, mpo na kozala na eloko oyo ezali kozala na ndenge ya kozala.
rule: Hedging na anglais ezali kosalema mpo na komonisa boye mabe, boye mabe to kobimisa. Ezali kotambola na: 1) Verbes modaux: may, might, could, can. Molongo: 'It might rain' (Ezali kozala boye mabe). 2) Adverbes ya kopona to boye mabe: usually, generally, apparently, presumably. Molongo: 'Apparently, he left early' (Aparentemente, azali kofungola makasi). 3) Verbes ya komonisa boye mabe: I think, I believe, I suppose, I tend to think. Molongo: 'I tend to agree with you' (Nazali komonisa boye mabe na yo). 4) Makasi ya kozala na mokolo: It seems that, It appears that, It is said that. Molongo: 'It seems that she is tired' (Ezali komonisa boye mabe). 5) Makasi ya 'tend to' + infinitif mpo na makasi to boye mabe. Molongo: 'He tends to arrive late' (Azali kozala na boye mabe). 6) 'Apparently' ezali kosalema mpo na makasi oyo tozali kozala na yango, mpe 'seemingly' ezali kosalema mpo na makasi ya kozala. 7) 'Rather' mpe 'quite' ezali kobimisa makasi. Molongo: 'It's rather expensive' (Ezali kozala na boye mabe). 8) Na makasi ya kozala, tozali kozua 'would seem' to 'could be argued' mpo na kozala na boye mabe. Kolinga boye mabe, na lingála tozali kozua mbula mpo na 'parece que', kasi na anglais tozali kozua indicatif: 'It seems that he is sick' (Ezali komonisa boye mabe).

concept_examples.translation: Ezali kozala boye mabe, kasi nazali kozala na boye mabe.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː meɪ biː leɪt bʌt aɪm nɒt ʃʊr/

common_error.wrong: I think that the project is feasible.
common_error.correct: I tend to think that the project is feasible.
common_error.correct_alt: It seems to me that the project is feasible.
common_error.explanation: Na lingála, 'pienso que' ezali kozala na boye mabe, kasi na anglais 'I think' ezali kozala na boye mabe na makasi ya kozala to mpo na komonisa boye mabe. Molongo ezali kotambola na kopesa ya lingála. Mpo na kozua hedging, tozali kozua 'I tend to think', 'I would say', to 'I suppose' mpo na kobimisa makambo. Boya kozua 'I think' mpo na kozala na boye mabe to ya kozala.

levels.label: Adverbs of Uncertainty
levels.translation: Adverbes ya boye mabe

examples.original: Apparently, the flight has been delayed.
examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli ðə flaɪt hæz biːn dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Aparentemente, vol ezali kozala na boye mabe.
examples.note: Tozali kozua 'apparently' mpo na makasi oyo tozali kozala na yango, kasi ezali kozala na boye mabe.

examples.original: Presumably, he has already finished the report.
examples.phonetic: /prɪˈzjuːməbli hiː hæz ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːt/
examples.translation: Presumiblemente, rapport ezali kozala na boye mabe.
examples.note: 'Presumably' ezali komonisa boye mabe, lokola 'probablemente' na lingála.

examples.original: Generally, people prefer to work in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛnərəli ˈpiːpəl prɪˈfɜːr tuː wɜːk ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Generalmente, biso tozali kozala na boye mabe ya kozala na makasi.
examples.note: 'Generally' ezali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala, kasi ezali kozala na boye mabe ya kozala.

levels.label: Modal Verbs for Hedging
levels.translation: Verbes modaux mpo na kobimisa

examples.original: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrɛlə/
examples.translation: Ezali kozala boye mabe ya kozala, mpo na kozua parapluie.
examples.note: 'Might' ezali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala ya kozala ya kozala. Na lingála, tozali kozua 'puede que'.

examples.original: Could you help me with this problem?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː hɛlp miː wɪð ðɪs ˈprɒbləm/
examples.translation: Ozali kozua mpo na kosala na mpo na kozala na mpo na kozala?
examples.note: 'Could' ezali kobimisa makasi, ezali kozala na boye mabe ya kozala ya kozala.

examples.original: This could be the best option for us.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə bɛst ˈɒpʃən fɔːr ʌs/
examples.translation: Ezali kozala boye mabe ya kozala mpo na biso.
examples.note: Tozali kozua 'could' mpo na komonisa boye mabe ya kozala, na boye mabe ya kozala.

levels.label: Impersonal Structures and Tendencies
levels.translation: Makasi ya kozala mpe boye mabe

examples.original: It seems that the prices have increased significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈɪnkriːst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Ezali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala ya kozala.
examples.note: 'It seems that' + indicatif, na boye mabe ya kozala na lingála.

examples.original: I tend to agree with the new policy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ tɛnd tuː əˈɡriː wɪð ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Nazali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala na politique ya kozala.
examples.note: 'Tend to' ezali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala, lokola 'soler' na lingála.

examples.original: She appears to be very confident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː əˈpɪərz tuː biː ˈvɛri ˈkɒnfɪdənt/
examples.translation: Ye azali komonisa boye mabe ya kozala na ye moko.
examples.note: 'Appears to' ezali kosalema mpo na makasi ya kozala, lokola 'parece' na lingála.
